# Employment Agreement

Wide World Importers Inc. offers you the position of Account Manager in
Ottawa, Ontario.

1. Time off. You receive 15 days of PTO per year.
2. Standards. Nothing in this agreement reduces your entitlements under the
   ESA.
3. Salary. $70,000 per year, less statutory deductions.
